title: Replace aggressive full-board polling with change-aware refresh
description:
## Goal
Preserve timely remote updates without every visible tab downloading and rebuilding an unchanged complete board every ten seconds.

## Acceptance
- [ ] The remote pull heartbeat defaults to a measured 30-second-or-longer cadence
- [ ] Browser refresh checks are lightweight or change-aware and do not fetch a complete board when its version is unchanged
- [ ] Local successful mutations update or refresh visible state promptly
- [ ] Visibility regain triggers a safe freshness check without overlapping requests
- [ ] Refresh intervals are configurable and documented by code-level constants or environment settings

## Acceptance Criteria
The concrete Acceptance checklist above passes in automated tests.

## Context
touches: src/lib/beads/sync-engine.ts, board API/client refresh flow, snapshot version metadata ; current identical 10-second client/server intervals caused measured 4-6 second contention stalls

## Out of scope
- Cross-process pub/sub infrastructure
- Guaranteed sub-second propagation of remote changes

## Verify
Add tests for unchanged-version responses, changed snapshots, visibility refresh, request deduplication, and configured heartbeat cadence; benchmark that unchanged refreshes avoid bd list.

title: Server-render initial board and ticket data

## Goal
Show useful board and ticket content on the initial server response so users do not wait for hydration followed by a second data request.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Board and ticket pages load their initial data on the server
- [ ] Client components initialize from serializable server-provided data without an immediate duplicate fetch
- [ ] Error and retry behavior remains usable
- [ ] URL ticket filters are applied correctly to initial server data

## Acceptance Criteria

## Context
touches: src/app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx, src/app/projects/[slug]/tickets/page.tsx, src/components/board/epic-board.tsx, src/components/tickets/tickets-view.tsx ; follow Next 16 server/client component guidance in node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/05-server-and-client-components.md

## Out of scope
- Removing board drag-and-drop or ticket client interactivity
- Static generation of repository data

## Verify
Add pure client-state tests where applicable and run page/build/typecheck gates; verify the first rendered state contains supplied board/ticket data.

title: Connect snapshot freshness to Beads writes and sync
description:
## Goal
Keep the repository snapshot correct after local mutations and remote pulls while ensuring reads never wait behind a Dolt synchronization pass.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Every successful Anton Beads mutation invalidates or refreshes the affected repository snapshot
- [ ] A successful remote pull invalidates or refreshes that snapshot once
- [ ] Readers can continue using the last valid snapshot while synchronization is active
- [ ] Bursts of writes and syncs coalesce refresh work rather than multiplying bd list calls

## Acceptance Criteria
The concrete Acceptance checklist above passes in automated tests.

## Context
touches: src/lib/beads/bd.ts, src/lib/beads/sync-engine.ts, snapshot module ; preserve the existing full/pull sync coalescer and sync status behavior

## Out of scope
- Changing Dolt remote semantics
- Making writes eventually consistent from the caller's perspective

## Verify
Add synchronization/invalidation tests covering successful writes, failed writes, successful pulls, failed pulls, and overlapping refresh requests.

title: Add a shared repository issue snapshot
description:
## Goal
Serve repeated Beads-backed reads from one safe per-repository snapshot so board and ticket views do not spawn duplicate bd processes.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Concurrent cold readers share one bd list invocation per repository
- [ ] Warm readers receive the cached snapshot without invoking bd
- [ ] Failed refreshes preserve the last valid snapshot and surface actionable diagnostics
- [ ] Board and ticket assembly consume the same snapshot source

## Acceptance Criteria
The concrete Acceptance checklist above passes in automated tests.

## Context
touches: src/lib/beads/bd.ts, a focused snapshot module, src/lib/board.ts, src/lib/tickets.ts ; follow the globalThis-anchored singleton and injected-dependency test patterns in src/lib/beads/sync-engine.ts

## Out of scope
- Persistent or distributed caching
- Reading passive issues.jsonl exports

## Verify
Add unit tests for cold load, concurrent deduplication, warm reuse, repository isolation, and failure with/without stale data; run existing board and ticket tests.
